coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Bay Commons

notes.accuracy_caveat: HIGH CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon tagged with the Mission Bay Parks system's own missionbayparks.com URL for this facility. Covers only this one mapped lot (roughly the Mission Bay Blvd. lawn/plaza between the Radiance and Nektar/Bayer buildings); the wider Mission Bay Commons interim-use area further west (Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens, the soccer field) is a separate, still-interim installation tracked as its own record below (Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons interim area) pending the Future Parks Project's 2028-2030 construction.

record.notes: Completed as part of Mission Bay's original 1998 plan, open by fall 2010 per Wikipedia's Mission Bay article.
